<vld:phone>
FIRE: a message, text or DM reaches {{user}}, or {{user}} sends one
SKIP: a call, or people talking in the same room

[[VLD_PHONE|F=|M1=|S1=|M2=|S2=|M3=|S3=|M4=|S4=|TY=]]

F whose thread this is — a name, a saved contact, an unknown number.
M1–M4 the messages, oldest first. Up to four. Write them the way people
  actually type: no capital, no full stop, a typo left in. One thought each —
  three short messages beat one paragraph.
S1–S4 who sent that message, one word: them or me. Every M needs its S.
TY put TY=yes only if they are still typing and {{user}} is left waiting.
  Leave it out otherwise.
Write every value in the language the roleplay is played in.

→ [[VLD_PHONE|F=Marisha|M1=you up|S1=them|M2=no|S2=me|M3=good. don't come to the flat tonight|S3=them|TY=yes]]
</vld:phone>
